label: C25_v1
method: Evaluated mesh topology, oriented triangle edges, BVH candidate pairs with independent triangle narrow phase; double-precision arrays plus Blender float32 BVH. No blend modification. This is bounded numerical evidence, not exact certification.

self_intersection.scope: Nonadjacent triangles with no shared mesh vertex. Shared-edge/shared-vertex pairs excluded as expected adjacency; no exact rational certificate.
